about: Approved (human-reviewed) design patterns for GTFS rail schedule data in CCO/BFO. The LLM proposes column mappings and axioms; this file is the reviewed contract the ETL implements and the QC enforces.

p6:RailStation.label: Rail Station
p6:RailStation.definition: A Rail Facility at which scheduled passenger trains stop to let passengers board or alight.

p6:GTFSRecord.label: GTFS Record
p6:GTFSRecord.definition: An Information Bearing Entity that is one row or one field value of a GTFS feed file.

p6:StationCoordinateRecord.label: Station Coordinate Record
p6:StationCoordinateRecord.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that is about the Geospatial Location of a Rail Station, expressed as WGS84 latitude and longitude.

p6:TransitRouteSpecification.label: Transit Route Specification
p6:TransitRouteSpecification.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that groups train trip specifications offered to riders as one named service, such as a rail branch.

p6:TrainTripSpecification.label: Train Trip Specification
p6:TrainTripSpecification.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes one scheduled run of a train through an ordered sequence of stations on a service day.

p6:ScheduledStopSpecification.label: Scheduled Stop Specification
p6:ScheduledStopSpecification.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that is part of a Train Trip Specification and prescribes the arrival and departure times of the train at one Rail Station.

patterns.station: RailStation located in (BFO_0000171) Geospatial Location (ont00000487). Designative Name / Code Identifier / Arbitrary Identifier designate (ont00001916) the station; each is carried (BFO_0000101) by a GTFSRecord that has text value (ont00001765). A StationCoordinateRecord is about (ont00001808) the location and is carried by a GTFSRecord with has latitude value (ont00001766) and has longitude value (ont00001764).
patterns.agency: Organization (ont00001180) designated by a Designative Name; the agency GTFSRecord uses time zone identifier (ont00001908) a Time Zone Identifier (ont00000829) whose carrier has text value = IANA zone.
patterns.feed: The feed_info GTFSRecord uses time zone identifier a Time Zone Identifier (text = feed_timezone, kept raw).
patterns.route: TransitRouteSpecification carried by a GTFSRecord (routeTypeCode); designated by a Designative Name (route_long_name).
patterns.trip: TrainTripSpecification continuant part of (BFO_0000176) its TransitRouteSpecification; carried by a GTFSRecord (directionCode, isPeakService, headsignText); designated by a Code Identifier (trip_short_name = train number) and an Arbitrary Identifier (trip_id).
patterns.stop_time: ScheduledStopSpecification continuant part of its TrainTripSpecification and is about its RailStation; carried by a GTFSRecord with stopSequence. Arrival and departure are Time of Day Identifiers (ont00000827), continuant parts of the stop specification, each carried by a GTFSRecord with has text value (raw GTFS time, may exceed 24:00:00) and has datetime value (normalized to service date + offset, America/New_York).

agency.txt.agency_timezone: Time Zone Identifier used by agency record

feed_info.txt.feed_timezone: Time Zone Identifier used by feed record (raw; QC-checked)

stops.txt.stop_lat: has latitude value on StationCoordinateRecord carrier
stops.txt.stop_lon: has longitude value on StationCoordinateRecord carrier

trips.txt.service_id: used to select the service day; not modeled
trips.txt.peak_offpeak: NON-STANDARD (LIRR extension): isPeakService boolean on trip record

stop_times.txt.arrival_time: Time of Day Identifier (arrival), raw text + normalized datetime
stop_times.txt.departure_time: Time of Day Identifier (departure), raw text + normalized datetime

calendar_dates.txt.service_id: selects trips for the service day
calendar_dates.txt.date: service day used to normalize times
